_readme: Community Board self-service content. Edit this file in the GitHub web UI (phone works) - the Lobby TV picks up changes within ~15 minutes. No PHI, no patient names, ever. POSTING A NEW EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH IS A PHONE EDIT ONLY - no publish, no code change: set eom.name / eom.role / eom.month / eom.lines and move eom.until to the last day you want the panel shown (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Once eom.until passes, the Lobby TV drops the panel from its rotation on its own; leaving it expired is fine and just means no kudos panel until the next winner is posted.
_readme_grvtv2: KILL SWITCH / FEATURE FLAGS for the GRVTV 2.0 boards - a PHONE EDIT, no publish, no code change; every 2.0 board re-reads this file every 15 minutes (plus GitHub's ~5 min cache), so a change lands on the wall within ~20 minutes. grvtv2.mode: "full" = the 2.0 board as designed; "v1" = only the approved 1.x panels play inside the 2.0 chrome (the 2.0 panels are hidden - use this if a new panel misbehaves); "lite" = the light look (no bed drift, no motes) for a box that stutters. grvtv2.hosts: the same per TV, keyed by the box's computer name (GRVTV-LOBBY, GRVTV-OPLOBBY, GRVTV-ACAFE, ...), wins over mode for that box. grvtv2.panels: a list of the 2.0 panel ids allowed to play (welcome, wx, otd, quote, agenda, menu); leave it out or null for all. grvtv2.video: false pauses every video on every 2.0 board. Anything malformed or unknown = full, never a blank wall. Only the 2.0 boards read this block; the 1.x boards ignore it. | signature (2026-09-25, runtime 2.1): the GRVTV Signature 24 scenes play only on the hosts listed here (or on every host when true; absent/false = off). Enable the pilot TV first, add hosts as the pilot proves out, remove a host to pull the scenes from it within 15 minutes, no publish needed.

eom.name: Rick Hrabe
lines: Sets the tone every shift with professionalism, compassion, and an unwavering commitment to patients and coworkers.
Brings out the best in everyone around him - steady, respectful, and leading by example.

quote.text: Where you tend a rose, my lad, a thistle cannot grow.

_readme_menu: Cafeteria menu TVs (GRV-CafeMenu-Signage.html). menu.roles: computer name -> now | day. menu.rotate: computer name -> none | cw | ccw, ONLY for a portrait TV whose Windows output is still landscape (fix Windows first). menu.moments: Kitchen Moments cooking films (enabled true/false as a JSON boolean; intervalMin; hosts.<NAME>.enabled). mode "generic" (2026-10-14) = the kitchen reel: generic kitchen footage full screen every intervalMin minutes on BOTH TVs, all day, MENU01 at hosts.GRVTVMENU01.offsetMin (1) and MENU02 at hosts.GRVTVMENU02.offsetMin (3.5) past each 5 minutes, so one TV always shows the menu and no film lands on a meal start; mode "menu" (or no mode) = the old dish-matched films on the 'now' TV only. To stop every film set enabled to false; to go back to the old behaviour set mode to "menu" and intervalMin to 8. menu.night (2026-10-15, engine cafe-menu 1.5.0): the night screen on BOTH TVs (navy sky, crescent moon, clouds, "Thank you for stopping by." / "The kitchen is closed for the night."), New York time from start to end (may cross midnight), no films at night, alerts still show; enabled must be the JSON boolean true; to turn it off set enabled to false or delete the block (takes effect within ~15 min). menu.theme (2026-10-15, cafe-menu 1.6.0): seasonal looks on BOTH TVs by New York date (schedule entries: theme autumn|thanksgiving|winter|newyear, start/end as MM-DD every year or YYYY-MM-DD one year, both ends included; optional override {theme, until} or "standard"); paused at night. menu.features: the feature strip (enabled, dwellSec, gapSec, order of ids from menu/features.json; only items with reviewStatus "approved" and in date show). To turn either off set its enabled to false or delete the block. Exact computer names, upper case.
